// One owned, private-data-disabled Gallery process; no browser or native host.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/cookiejar"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/tmp/appkit-stream-gallery.3X5D1A/gallery", "-addr", "127.0.0.1:0", "-design-assets=")
	pipe, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
	must(err)
	must(cmd.Start())
	defer func() {
		if cmd.ProcessState == nil {
			_ = cmd.Process.Kill()
		}
	}()
	urlReady := make(chan string, 1)
	go func() {
		s := bufio.NewScanner(pipe)
		for s.Scan() {
			if _, u, ok := strings.Cut(s.Text(), "app-kit Gallery → "); ok {
				urlReady <- u
				return
			}
		}
		urlReady <- ""
	}()
	var base string
	select {
	case base = <-urlReady:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		panic("owned process did not publish its listener")
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(base, "http://127.0.0.1:") {
		panic("unexpected listener")
	}
	jar, err := cookiejar.New(nil)
	must(err)
	transport := &http.Transport{Proxy: nil}
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	client := &http.Client{Jar: jar, Transport: transport, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	get := func(path, accept string) *http.Response {
		r, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, base+path, nil)
		must(err)
		if accept != "" {
			r.Header.Set("Accept", accept)
		}
		res, err := client.Do(r)
		must(err)
		if res.StatusCode != 200 {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("status %d", res.StatusCode))
		}
		return res
	}
	page := get("/shell/profile", "")
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(page.Body, 65537))
	must(err)
	must(page.Body.Close())
	if len(body) > 65536 || !strings.Contains(string(body), "Alex Morgan") {
		panic("unexpected synthetic profile")
	}
	stream := get("/shell/events", "text/event-stream")
	defer stream.Body.Close()
	if stream.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "text/event-stream" {
		panic("not an event response")
	}
	reader := bufio.NewReader(stream.Body)
	var id, event, data string
	for {
		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
		must(err)
		if line == "\n" {
			break
		}
		if len(line) > 8192 {
			panic("event line budget")
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "id: ") {
			id = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "id: "))
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "event: ") {
			event = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "event: "))
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: signals ") {
			data = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: signals "))
		}
	}
	var payload struct {
		Probe struct {
			Version string `json:"version"`
			Name    string `json:"display_name"`
		} `json:"appkitShellProbe"`
	}
	must(json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &payload))
	if id != "1" || event != "datastar-patch-signals" || payload.Probe.Version != "1" || payload.Probe.Name != "Alex Morgan" {
		panic("initial snapshot mismatch")
	}
	started := time.Now()
	must(cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM))
	waited := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { waited <- cmd.Wait() }()
	select {
	case err := <-waited:
		must(err)
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		panic("SIGTERM did not exit within 3s")
	}
	remainder, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, 8193))
	must(err)
	if len(remainder) != 0 {
		panic("unexpected data after canceled stream")
	}
	r, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, base+"/shell", nil)
	must(err)
	if res, err := client.Do(r); err == nil {
		res.Body.Close()
		panic("owned listener stayed open")
	}
	fmt.Printf("owned_pid=%d profile=200 initial_snapshot=pass active_stream_SIGTERM_exit=0 stream_EOF=pass listener_closed=pass elapsed=%s browser_native=unverified\n", cmd.Process.Pid, time.Since(started).Round(time.Millisecond))
}
